scope: Selected public sources. No intake attachments or private source paths. Review depth is distinct from experimental evidence.

entries.title: Multi-resonant THz modulation with thin-film lithium niobate
entries.possible_insight: TFLN with three QBIC resonances converts small optical-pump perturbations into THz transmission changes.
entries.scope_limit: Reported maximum modulation is about 0.8% under 532 nm CW pumping; future electrical tuning is not the demonstrated result.
entries.fabrication_and_precision: 600 nm x-cut LN film and patterned resonator supercell; retrieve lateral dimensions and tolerance budget.
entries.next_action: Read methods and quantify required pump, response speed, losses and drift before modeling a module.

entries.title: Sub-Micron Resolution, Large-Scale Magnetic Printing of Orthorhombic Photonic Crystals
entries.possible_insight: Magnetic alignment at a drying front assembles photonic structures from nanorods; candidate bottom-up upgrade process.
entries.scope_limit: The 750 nm minimum reported domain width uses lithographically patterned channels and a 0.3 T field; it is not arbitrary 750 nm placement.
entries.fabrication_and_precision: Fe3O4@SiO2 nanorod ink, drying and template confinement; qualify material synthesis, template, defects and optical response.
entries.next_action: Extract process from methods/SI; compare externally seeded templates with machine-made fixtures and automated drying/field control.

entries.title: Terahertz generation from chirped and delayed laser pulses in a periodically poled lithium niobate waveguide
entries.possible_insight: Optically pumped waveguide source demonstrates generation around 488 GHz; precedent for a compact conversion module.
entries.scope_limit: Source generation is distinct from spatial-mode selection and arbitrary field control.
entries.fabrication_and_precision: 500 × 500 µm waveguide cross-section; include poling, ultrafast pump, coupling and detection in effort budget.
entries.next_action: Reproduce frequency/phase-matching calculation; quantify full-system efficiency and effort only for a named sensing need.

entries.title: Atomic lithography of two dimensional nanostructures
entries.possible_insight: SLM interference fields steer an incoming atomic beam onto substrate locations electronically.
entries.scope_limit: Example region about 3 × 3 µm; serial writing and multi-spot crosstalk discussed. Patent is not evidence of a built general printer.
entries.fabrication_and_precision: Atomic beam, suitable laser/SLM and vacuum substrate process; surface growth and throughput require separate models.
entries.next_action: Reproduce a source example and compare captured mass rate, area and feature quality against conventional deposition.

entries.title: Pattern formation method and apparatus using atomic beam holography technology
entries.possible_insight: Holographic diffraction/reflection of a coherent atomic matter wave.
entries.scope_limit: Not optical-force steering of a thermal atom beam; patent example uses about 50 µK atoms.
entries.fabrication_and_precision: Coherent atomic source and atomic hologram/reflection interfaces; manufacturing and coherence budgets unresolved.
entries.next_action: Assess source/coherence burden before considering integration; keep separate from dipole-force trajectory model.

entries.title: Particle beam device
entries.possible_insight: Periodic static fields acting on a moving beam offer a beam-state-conditioning analogy.
entries.scope_limit: Purpose is generating radiation from high-energy particles, not deposition; no manufacturing capability established.
entries.fabrication_and_precision: Accelerator and evacuated interaction structure; not a P0 seed component.
entries.next_action: Retain as background; require a specific lower-energy manufacturing benefit before further work.

entries.title: Laser Focused Atomic Deposition
entries.possible_insight: Laser standing waves focus chromium during deposition on silicon.
entries.scope_limit: Reported lines 65 nm wide, 34 nm high over 0.4 mm × 1 mm in about ten minutes; not arbitrary 3D fabrication.
entries.fabrication_and_precision: Atomic beam, laser and substrate-growth process; distinguish incident focus from deposited profile.
entries.next_action: Use as a benchmark for optical-force/deposition calculations, with process parameters from full paper.

entries.title: Direct printing of metasurfaces using formulated optical materials
entries.possible_insight: TiO2 nanoparticle-resin replication is a candidate bridge from a purchased seed master to working optical plates.
entries.scope_limit: Replication still needs master/molds, material preparation and qualification; not an active transducer demonstration.
entries.fabrication_and_precision: High-index resin and nanoimprint process; establish shrinkage, defects, optical loss and geometry sensitivity.
entries.next_action: Extract complete recipe/access requirements and compare outsourced master plus replication against direct fabrication.

entries.title: Holograms for acoustics
entries.possible_insight: Printed polymer phase plates shape an incident acoustic field; candidate passive replacement for some control hardware.
entries.scope_limit: A fixed transform does not supply arbitrary dynamic control; medium and task must match the precedent.
entries.fabrication_and_precision: Printed polymer hologram; derive phase-height, loss and registration tolerance for our medium.
entries.next_action: Compare passive insert with direct drive on the same task, power and field-quality criteria.

entries.title: Two-Dimensional Manipulation in Mid-Air Using a Single Transducer Acoustic Levitator
entries.possible_insight: Vibrating plate plus reflector uses frequency switching to move a levitated cluster along predefined 2D trajectories.
entries.scope_limit: Demonstrates restricted trajectories, not arbitrary 3D multi-trap fields or our six-actuator geometry.
entries.fabrication_and_precision: Piezo stack bonded to a 50 mm square silicon plate; reflector alignment and temperature matter.
entries.next_action: Extract coupled response and switching dynamics; benchmark the minimal-drive model on a comparable task.

entries.title: Systematic Design and Experimental Demonstration of Transmission-Type Multiplexed Acoustic Metaholograms
entries.possible_insight: Passive unit cells encode different acoustic patterns at different frequencies.
entries.scope_limit: Frequency-selected predefined patterns do not establish arbitrary per-pixel programmability or stable particle handling.
entries.fabrication_and_precision: Two Fabry–Perot channels per cell; obtain dimensions, loss and bandwidth before scaling.
entries.next_action: Compare frequency-dependent passive aperture patterns with the pressure and force patterns required by AC-03.

entries.title: Power Ultrasonic Transducers — Langevin transducer brochure
entries.possible_insight: Power piezo source option with application-specific design and drive electronics.
entries.scope_limit: Mechanical quality factor is not the mounted plate bandwidth; electrical update rate does not establish acoustic modulation bandwidth.
entries.fabrication_and_precision: Piezo rings, preload and mechanical assembly must be modeled with the attached plate and radiative loading.
entries.next_action: Select a concrete source model and calculate loaded frequency response, force, thermal load and ring-down before choosing Langevin.

entries.title: Langevin Transducers Incorporating TPMS Lattice Front Masses
entries.evidence_status: conference abstract reports fabricated and characterized devices
entries.possible_insight: Powder-bed-fused lattice front masses co-designed with Langevin stacks; modal FEA checked using impedance and vibrometry.
entries.scope_limit: Around-20-kHz power-transducer work; not arbitrary multiport airborne trapping. Conference abstract is not a full methods audit.
entries.fabrication_and_precision: TPMS front masses; micro-CT examines structure and excitation-associated cracks. Process and fatigue qualification matter.
entries.next_action: Obtain full methods, material/process details and measured response before using as a quantitative benchmark.

entries.title: Parametric Study of Bolt Clamping Effect on Resonance Characteristics of Langevin Transducers with Lumped Circuit Models
entries.possible_insight: Preload and masses influence impedance and resonance; use a coupled transducer model for a replacement printed body.
entries.scope_limit: Source-specific geometry and torque; do not transfer its preload values directly to another stack.
entries.fabrication_and_precision: Preloaded piezoceramic rings, front/rear masses and bolt; contact faces and load path are functional components.
entries.next_action: Use modeling approach to bound preload/contact sensitivity of the chosen cartridge or custom front-mass assembly.

entries.title: Holographic acoustic elements for manipulation of levitated objects
entries.authors: Marzo, Seah, Drinkwater, Sahoo, Long, Subramanian
entries.possible_insight: Drive optimisation on the Gor'kov potential: maximise its Laplacian and minimise pressure at the target. Same force model as the twin; the AC-03a inner problem constrains rest position and the weakest trap frequency instead.
entries.scope_limit: Phased arrays of 10 mm 40 kHz transmitters at 16 V p-p moving 0.6–3.1 mm polystyrene; many independent channels, not few strong ports.
entries.fabrication_and_precision: Catalog 40 kHz transmitters; no made acoustic part.
entries.next_action: Benchmark the inner solver against a published trap shape if a case with full geometry is found.
entries.decision: reference for the AC-03a reduced model; no architecture adoption

entries.title: Observer Patch Holography: programme, basis and formal library
entries.possible_insight: Interfaces, shared records and geometry suggest compact module representations and feedback.
entries.scope_limit: The upstream programme states that full agreement with observed measurement statistics is not established; formal results retain their premises.
entries.fabrication_and_precision: No component recipe follows solely from a formal carrier or port count.
entries.next_action: Attach any proposed physical mechanism to a specific response model, observable and independent comparison.
entries.decision: reference for physics handbook; no hardware capability promotion

entries.title: NIST Atomic Spectra Database
entries.possible_insight: Element and ion spectra provide quantitative identification and interaction data.
entries.scope_limit: A spectrum is a set of transitions; it is not a universal audible note or a manufacturing recipe.
entries.fabrication_and_precision: Specify species, ionization state, transition, environment and instrument.
entries.next_action: Select transitions and coupling data for a named sensing or optical process.
entries.decision: reference for physics handbook; no hardware capability promotion

entries.title: Atomic Spectroscopy — Spectral Lines
entries.possible_insight: Transition probabilities and selection rules explain why frequency matching alone is insufficient.
entries.scope_limit: Atomic transition models do not describe the elastic response of a macroscopic component.
entries.fabrication_and_precision: Use the physical state and interaction appropriate to the process.
entries.next_action: Include coupling strength and linewidth with every proposed spectral control.
entries.decision: reference for physics handbook; no hardware capability promotion

entries.title: The Universal One
entries.possible_insight: A unified picture of form and organized motion motivates questions about geometry and stable patterns.
entries.scope_limit: Russell uses light in a metaphysical sense; the book does not validate element-to-tone machine settings.
entries.fabrication_and_precision: No fabrication specification inferred from the historical chart.
entries.next_action: Translate a proposed correspondence into a quantitative observable before using it as a design input.
entries.decision: reference for physics handbook; no hardware capability promotion

entries.title: Kilogram: Mass and Planck’s Constant
entries.identifier: NIST SI redefinition: mass and Planck constant
entries.possible_insight: Clarifies the relations between photon energy, frequency and rest energy.
entries.scope_limit: An energy-equivalent frequency is not automatically a material resonance.
entries.fabrication_and_precision: A usable process still requires a coupling, bandwidth and energy budget.
entries.next_action: Use frequency conversions only for explicitly identified physical quantities.
entries.decision: reference for physics handbook; no hardware capability promotion

entries.title: The Standard Model
entries.possible_insight: Distinguishes electromagnetic radiation from ordinary matter particles in the physical model.
entries.scope_limit: The overview does not validate a common-substrate ontology or a Replicator process.
entries.fabrication_and_precision: No fabrication route is specified by this classification.
entries.next_action: Retain the relevant interaction physics when translating unifying ideas into module models.
entries.decision: reference for physics handbook; no hardware capability promotion

entries.title: Compact holographic sound fields enable rapid one-step assembly of matter in 3D
entries.possible_insight: Multiple acoustic holograms arrange particles into three-dimensional structures, with fixation routes.
entries.scope_limit: Reported material and apparatus scope applies; particle assembly is distinct from atomic crystal growth.
entries.fabrication_and_precision: Hologram geometry, acoustic medium, feedstock and consolidation require qualification.
entries.next_action: Compare a reported assembly case with the intended feed and first useful part.
entries.decision: reference for physics handbook; no hardware capability promotion
